_note: The v3 pack's IoT connectivity flow (screen 30, 'From her arm to her nurse'), as an explainer of the path a reading would take — not a status. Nothing on this path is connected in this preview: no device is paired, no phone or hub relays anything, no cloud receives a reading and nobody is notified. The pack marks South African hosting To confirm and so does this. The pack's lanes never reach a family screen and neither does anything here. Its pairing screen is not drawn either: pairing is not built, and a Connect button that pairs nothing would be the first thing on this screen to lie.
title: How a reading would reach your nurse
lead: The path a reading would take once a device is paired. Nothing on it is connected in this preview.

steps.name: A device at home
steps.detail: Takes a reading, such as blood pressure, in front of you.

steps.name: Your phone or a hub
steps.detail: Hears the device over Bluetooth. With no signal, it keeps the reading, with its time, and sends it later in order.

steps.name: A secure store
steps.detail: Encrypted on the way and at rest. Where it is hosted is still to confirm.

steps.name: A nurse reviews
steps.detail: A person reads it, never an automated score.

steps.name: A doctor decides
steps.detail: If something needs a decision, a registered doctor makes it.

notConnected: None of this is connected. No reading leaves any device for this account.

pairing.title: Pair a device
pairing.refusal: Pairing is not built yet, so no device can be paired to you in this preview.
